items.quote: Leandro of America Power Electric was a true professional. After a quick analysis of the two projects we had for him, he went right to work and completed the installations exactly how we had hoped for. He was on time, knowledgeable, kept a clean workspace and also offered some insight into a few additional projects that we would like to complete in the home. He has instantly become our go to electrician. Highly recommended!

Amazing electrician! Very professional and ethical. Resolved the problem with my generator not providing enough power to the house. Leo went above and beyond to fix the problem. Very fair fees as well.

Leandro was fantastic from start to finish. He reviewed my issue, answered questions and provided an estimate over the phone as able, was very accommodating with my schedule, and arrived early with a text message update on his arrival time. He was professional and completed the work quickly and skillfully, and had a very fair price. I talked to him about some other projects I may want to do, and will definitely use him again in the future! Would recommend to anyone!
